The '''Dusk Shadow''' was a [[Terentatek/Legends|Terentatek]] that wandered [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]].

==History==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] came to the Dune Sea at the request of their companion [[Qyzen Fess]]; feeling shame over losing his score on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] wanted to make amends to the [[Scorekeeper/Legends|Scorekeeper]] by going to Tatooine and paying homage to the bones of his father.

After finding and honoring the bones, a [[Lek Svaal|Trandoshan hunter]] came by the two, saying that the Dusk Shadow was eating the farmers' [[Bantha/Legends|Banthas]] and that he was hunting it down by placing bombs, but the two were in the area of the supposed mine field. After their argument, the Dusk Shadow made its appearance, resulting in Lek running away and the Dusk Shadow engaging the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Qyzen. It was killed by their combined actions.
